name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: Fighting continues in the Kivus without major gains, as cholera and Ebola spread
state: Clashes between Congolese forces and AFC/M23 continue in North and South Kivu, including against Wazalendo militias, without a major city changing hands (Critical Threats; AllAfrica). UN agencies say cholera cases spiked in October as the country also fights Ebola (UN News). Searches on 7 Nov found no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to North and South Kivu.
rubric_hit: Active fighting without city capture = Watch

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
